title: [CINEMATIC SETUP]
content:
[CINEMATIC SETUP]
Cinematic sci-fi short, lonely contemplative tone shifting to
quiet wonder, desaturated dusty earth-and-grey color grade with a
single glowing blue accent, overcast alien daylight, slow
deliberate camera with macro close-ups, 35mm anamorphic,
emotionally grounded realism.

[CHARACTERS]
The Robot: a worn humanoid exploration robot, scratched off-white
and grey metal plating, exposed cables and joints, a smooth domed
head with glowing blue eyes, moving with slow weary curiosity.

[LOCATION]
A vast desolate alien desert under a heavy overcast sky, rocky red-
brown terrain, distant rock formations and mesas, cracked dry
ground, dust drifting in the wind.

[TIMELINE]
[0:00–3] (panels 1–2) Wide establishing tracking — The Robot walks
alone across the vast desolate alien landscape through rocky dusty
terrain, tiny against the immense horizon, dust drifting.
[3–6] (panels 3–4) Over-the-shoulder into close-up — The Robot
pauses and scans the horizon, then its head tilts as its glowing
blue eyes react to a faint anomaly ahead.
[6–9] (panels 5–6) Wide shot with HUD — a subtle glowing blue
sensor marker pulses in the distance, and The Robot crosses dunes
and broken ground walking toward the signal.
[9–12] (panels 7–8) Low shot — The Robot kneels at the source
point and studies the soil, a small holographic blue scan
flickering up from its hand reading a faint biosignature.
[12–15] (panels 9–12) Extreme macro into final reveal — The
Robot's metal fingers gently brush aside the dust to reveal a tiny
sprout in the cracked ground, which unfolds into a delicate glowing
blue luminous flower, The Robot softly blurred behind it in awe.

[SFX]
Soft howling wind, crunching gravel under heavy footsteps, faint
servo whirs, a gentle electronic scan tone, a soft chime as the
flower blooms, quiet ambience.

[QUALITY ANCHOR]
Photorealistic 4K, consistent robot design matching the reference,
stable mechanical anatomy, coherent desaturated lighting with the
single glowing blue accent, realistic dust and macro detail,
emotional readability, no flicker, no deformation, no morphing.
